metadata.creator: Samsung
metadata.description:
The Match: Striker Soccer G11 is a free mobile game created by the tech company Samsung that was released around the time of their huge Galaxy 11 Soccer Match Super Bowl commercial that put professional soccer players up against aliens looking to take over the world by defeating humans in a game of soccer to determine who wins control of Earth.

The game is pretty barebones, as most of the budget was spent creating the actual commercial. It allows you to play as the entire Galaxy 11 roster, and battle the aliens in soccer. The game was very well received despite the problems. But, like most advergames, it didn't last long, and was pulled from the App Store and Google Play Store.

This is one of the only remaining copies of the game's XAPK file, which contains OBB data that allows the game to function. To install it, you will need to use a XAPK installer app from the Play Store, or else the file will not open. This game does not have any archives of it surrounding anywhere, so to ensure that the game doesn't become scarce again, it has been uploaded here, to the Internet Archive, for longterm preservation, just in case the files are pulled from the internet one day.
